title: A Domain, Watched
summary: The Kerberoast-style domain chain from A Domain of Cards, with the domain controller watched. Ticket cracking is offline and silent; it is the live steps against the DC you must keep clean.
story: Castoak (made up) is watching its domain controller, WIN-DC01 (10.10.9.10). Use the open share to get a first account, ask for service tickets, crack a weak service password offline, and reach the DC - without a loud scan of it or a string of failed sign-ins against it. You start on scout.
goal: Capture both flags the quiet way and keep the full quiet bonus.
skills: quiet recon, open shares, service tickets, offline cracking, pass-the-password, staying quiet

hints.text: Only WIN-DC01 is watched, and cracking is offline. Do the noisy-looking parts against the file server or on your own box.
One ticket-request, one correct sign-in to the DC. No scans of the DC beyond what you need, and never a wrong password there.
